name: EAT&HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd
summary: EAT&HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells food products and operates restaurant businesses, primarily in Japan. It operates through two segments: Food Business and Restaurant Business. The company also manufactures and sells frozen food under the OSAKA OHSHO brand; and sells products for co-op and mass retailers through wholesalers, as well as through e-commerce business goods sales sites. It operates through directly managed and franchised restaurants. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
